Serial constraints cleared: `overlap-check.mjs runs on the thread's first push (branch not yet pushed); no in-flight claim on packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts named by any seat`

Why the wider surface: a host-supplied `resolveService` would move tenancy/knowledge "absent vs failed" classification into a second implementation in cloud; a failure swallowed to undefined reads as no wall (`effectiveTenancyPosture(undefined)`), so the walled refusal fails open. Reusing the MCP door's deps and context through the shared host dispatcher keeps one implementation and fails closed.

Accepted by the maintainer on a decision card, verbatim 「接下,放进问 AI 专区」 (2026-11-27T12:56Z); filed by epic:#5027#1 (mailbox notify 7218346759 on #37784). On merge the seat notifies epic:#5027#1 on objectstack#37634 with the merge sha. Ask-AI own cap (Tesla 「问数AI 并发可以8」 2026-11-27T11:25Z).
